sections.heading: Share Information
sections.text:
As of June 30, 2026, the Bank has 65,058 shareholders.
The authorized capital of BBVA Colombia amounts to $645,000,000,000, represented by 103,365,384,615 shares. Of these, 85,576,658,507 correspond to shares in reserve or pending subscription.
The par value of each share is six pesos and twenty-four cents ($6.24).
The BBVA Colombia's share is traded on the Colombian Stock Exchange. For information regarding the share price please access the following websites: www.bvc.com.co or www.superfinanciera.gov.co.

sections.heading: Dividend Payment
sections.text:
The General Shareholders' Meeting of BBVA Colombia, in an ordinary meeting held on March 25, 2026, approved the distribution of profits corresponding to the 2025 financial year and the payment of dividends for the value of $4.88 per ordinary share and $15 per share with preferential dividend without voting rights.
Which will be paid in cash, in a single installment, on June 11, 2026. According to the payment dates, the ex-dividend period will take place between June 4 and 10, 2026.
REQUIREMENTS TO MAKE PAYMENT OF DIVIDENDS
It must be presented:
Original (s) of the title (s) corresponding to the shares.
ID document: ID for natural persons and Copy of the first certified page of the RUT (Single Tax Registry) for legal persons.
Certificate from Cámara de Comercio (Legal Entities) whose issuance date does not exceed 30 calendar days.
Letter of authorization and photocopy of the authenticated citizenship card (For payments to third parties).
Letter of authorization from the shareholder to credit the account.

sections.heading: Shareholders
sections.text: What is a Share? What is a preferred share? What is an common share? What are dividends? What is the ex-dividend period? What is a convey? How do I sell my shares of BBVA COLOMBIA? What is the market value?

sections.heading: What is a Share?
sections.text: It's a variable-yield security that provides a fraction by which any person (individual or legal entity) participates in the share capital of the issuing company, converting it into a Shareholder and giving it a share in the company's profits. Moreover, shareholders get benefits for the valuation of the stock price in the Stock Exchange. It is called variable income because its profitability depends on the performance of the company and its profits generated, and variations in the price of the property on the stock market.

sections.heading: What is a preferred share?
sections.text: It gives its holder a priority in payment of dividends and/or in case of liquidation of the company, the capital repayment. Preferred shares have economic prerogatives that may be cumulative, according to the statutes. However, preferred shares do not have voting rights, with some exceptions.

sections.heading: What is an common share?
sections.text: Common shares receive the economic benefits of the company and have voting rights in the general shareholders’ meeting.

sections.heading: What are dividends?
sections.text: It's the part of net profit that is paid periodically on each share at the end of a given fiscal year, which final assessment has been entrusted by law to the general shareholders' meeting.

sections.heading: What is the ex-dividend period?
sections.text:
According to the definition established by the Bolsa de Valores de Colombia, is the time between the date of dividend payment and the 4 trading days immediately preceding the date of the dividend payment. In that period, who buys shares has not right to receive dividends.
In Colombia, trading non-working days are holidays only.

sections.heading: What is a convey?
sections.text: It is a transaction by which a natural or legal person transfers the ownership of their share certificates to another. It can be direct or indirect.

sections.heading: How do I sell my shares of BBVA COLOMBIA?
sections.text:
Regarding the sale of shares, it's worth mentioned that there are two ways for doing it:
1. Through colombian stockbroker societies.
2. Through direct sale to a person or legal entity outside the securities exchange, given that the value of the transaction does not exceed 66.000 UVR's*.

sections.heading: What is the market value?
sections.text: It's the value per share determined by the Bolsa de Valores de Colombia based on supply and demand of the shares.
